name: Dfplayer → Set Current Track Repeat
description: Enables or disables repeat playback of the track that is already playing. Unlike the `loop` option of `dfplayer.play`, it can be sent after playback has started, and disabling it lets a looping track finish normally instead of stopping it. It applies only to the current track; the next track selected plays once unless the action is sent again.

config_entries.label: ID
config_entries.description: Manually specify the ID of the DFPlayer if you have multiple components.

config_entries.label: Enable
config_entries.description: Whether the current track should repeat. Defaults to `true`, so the bare action turns repeat on.
